translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: “Pacha chuna ni nyaka adwoki
nikech gima iwacho chando chunya.
Asewinjo kwer mikwerago, manyisa ni ichaya,
omiyo kaluwore gi ngʼeyo ma an-go,
to chuna ni nyaka adwoki.
“Ingʼeyo maber chal gik moko nyaka aa chon,
chakre kinde mane oket dhano e piny,
ni tingʼruok ma joma timbegi richo tingʼorego rumo piyo,
kendo mor mar joma okia Nyasaye ok bed amingʼa.
Kata bed ni sungane chopo nyaka e polo
kendo wiye mulo boche polo,
to ibiro yweye molal nono mana ka buru;
joma yande ongʼeye nopenj ni, ‘Kare tinde erego?’
Olal nono mana ka lek,
kendo ok chak yud ndache iriembe modhi mabor,
mana ka lek mar otieno.
Wenge ma yande nene ok nochak onene;
kendo kama nodakie ok nochak onene.
Nyithinde nyaka dwok gik mane okwalo kuom jodhier,
adier nyithinde nyaka dwok mwandu mane omayo ji.
Tekone duto kaka ngʼama pod tin
biro dhi kode e bur.
“Kata obedo ni richo mitne e dhoge
mopando moko e lembe,
kata obedo ni ok onyal pogore kode
kendo okane ei dande iye,
to chiembe biro lokore makech gie iye;
obiro lokore kwiri marach mag thuonde madongo manie iye.
Nyasaye biro ngʼulo mwandu mane omwonyo oko;
obiro miyo ongʼogogi oko ka chiemo mocham.
Obiro nyodho kwiri mag thuonde madongo;
kendo leke thuond fu man-gi kwiri maricho biro nege.
Ok enobed mangima
ma one mo mar kich gi chak mamol ka aore.
Gik mane oyudo kuom tichne matek obiro weyo
kendo ok obi yudo thuolo mar bedo mamor kuom ohala mosechoko.
Nikech ne othiro joma odhier, kendo nomayogi gigegi
mi gidongʼ nono osemayo ji udi ma en ne ok ogero.
“Adier, ok obi yudo yweyo kuom gombone malach;
nikech ok onyal warore owuon gi mwandu mangʼeny mokano.
Onge gima odongʼne makoro onyalo yako;
mwandune ok bi siko.
Kata bed ni oseyako mwandu mangʼeny kamano;
to mwandugo ema biro kelone masira;
kendo midhiero maduongʼ biro biro kuome mi hewe.
Kosechiemo moyiengʼ,
to Nyasaye biro olo kuome mirimbe maliel ka mach,
kendo biro kelo kuome kum malich.
Kata otem ringo mondo otony ne gir lweny molos gi chuma,
to asere ma dhoge olos gi mula biro chwowe.
Opudho asereno mondo owuog oko gi yo ka die ngʼeye,
ka lew asere mabithno to osechwoyo adundone.
Kihondko biro biro kuome,
nikech mwandune duto oserumo.
Mach ma lwet dhano ok omoko biro wangʼe molokre buru
kendo biro tieko gimoro amora modongʼ e hembe.
Polo biro bedo janeno kuom timbene mamono duto;
to piny nongʼadne bura.
Ohula maduongʼ biro yweyo ode mi dhigo, adier,
pi maringo matek biro tere chiengʼ ma Nyasaye noolie mirimbe mager.
Mano e gima Nyasaye ochano ne joma timbegi richo,
mano e girkeni ma Nyasaye oikonegi.”
